title: lobelia anceps var. minor
intro: Lobelia anceps var. minor, commonly known as Lobelia minor, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lobeliaceae family. It is native to North America and is known for its medicinal properties. Lobelia minor has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including lobeline and lobelanine, exhibit therapeutic actions, such as bronchodilation, and have been reported to have antioxidant, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
